source: Your own server code is not covered by default, because the errors you get are what show you where the work is. When {0} is off, {1} lists the files in your {2} directory that import from {3}, import h3 v1 helpers that h3 v2 no longer exports, or read {4}. If your project depends on h3 v1 itself, {5} imports in your server code resolve to it rather than to h3 v2, and {6} lists the files importing from {7} until you remove the dependency or turn on {8}. If you want to ship the upgrade before doing that work, turn on {9}:
